description_en: Create a data delivery task to deliver metric data from a data source to a storage destination or message queue. This task supports three delivery types: Prometheus Remote Write, Kafka, and MaxCompute. You can also use tags to filter which metrics are delivered and attach custom tags to them
description_zh: 创建数据投递任务，将指定数据源的指标数据投递至目标存储或消息队列，支持 Prometheus Remote Write、Kafka、MaxCompute 三种投递类型。支持通过标签过滤指定投递的指标范围，以及为投递指标附加自定义标签
kebab_example: aliyun cms create-delivery-task --task-name my-task --data-source-id rw-xxxxxx --task-description my_delivery_task --label-filters-type Allow --label-filters key=example-string --external-labels key=example-string --sink-list '[{"sinkConfigs":{"key":"example-string"},"sinkType":"Prometheus"}]' --resource-group-id rg-ae000000ey --tags value=test key=cms_workspace --api-version 2024-03-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDeliveryTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Prometheus instance that serves as the data source
parameters.help_zh: 数据源 ID（Prometheus 实例 ID）
parameters.name: data_source_id

parameters.help_en: A map of key-value pairs to attach as additional labels to all delivered metrics
parameters.help_zh: 为所有投递指标附加的额外 label，key 为 label 名，value 为 label 值
parameters.name: external_labels

parameters.help_en: The label conditions for filtering metrics. The key is the label name and the value is the value to match. The filtering behavior is controlled by `labelFiltersType`
parameters.help_zh: 指标过滤条件，配合 labelFiltersType 使用，key 为指标 label 名，value 为匹配值
parameters.name: label_filters

parameters.help_en: The mode for applying the label filters
parameters.name: label_filters_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The configuration for the sink, specified as key-value pairs. The valid keys and values depend on the value of `sinkType`
fields.help_zh: 投递目标详细配置，key/value 含义因 sinkType 不同而不同（见下方说明）
fields.name: sink_configs

fields.help_en: The type of the delivery destination (sink)
fields.name: sink_type

parameters.help_en: An array of delivery destination objects
parameters.name: sink_list

fields.help_en: The key of the resource tag
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the resource tag
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The name of the task. The name can contain Chinese characters, English letters, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，支持中文、英文、下划线、中划线
parameters.name: task_name

schema.description_en: The data returned in the response

requestId.description_en: The unique ID for the request

taskId.description_en: The ID of the delivery task
